title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode5 Action!

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Amisawa, do you have a minute? I want to ask you a few things about the film equipment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? What are you watching...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, this? It's drone footage.
The person took shots from a bunch of different angles instead of just from up above.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and they took some really nice footage.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Isn't it amazing how much technology has advanced? Did you know that people started making motion pictures all the way back in the 19th century? It began with this device called a “cinematograph”.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to get sidetracked! Asking my dad about this stuff sorta lit this fire inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
I can tell that you like cameras very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm also really interested in that, but...
Mind if I ask about the equipment...?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Hiyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Soda, what are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Oh, I was just practicing for the film!
I've been going to this one judo dojo for a really long time, and the kids there said they wanted to see our film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why you sound so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm going to do whatever it takes!
Get ready for some really cool fight scenes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'll be looking forward to those...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
T-Tachibana...?
You've been staring at me for a while now. Is there something on my face...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, it's not that.
Hey, Director, wanna go clothes shopping together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Why...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: After watching you work, I kinda want to dress you up in some nice clothes, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh, lemme think about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kusanagi.
What can I do to become a better actor?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tried recording a video of myself acting, but my delivery was a bit...no, really stiff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna go all out, especially for the last part! Can you teach me how to sound more convincing?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna learn how to do that too.
The cast needs to be on top of their game for this film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
I might not be the best teacher, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
Please teach us, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Alright, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We finally start shooting tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We've been really busy until today, but I've had a chance to talk to everyone... I feel a lot more comfortable around them now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope our shoot goes well...)
Shoot Location

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow... This is where we're shooting?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
This is awesome...!
Just look at those cliffs! It's the perfect location!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Amisawa's group found it for us.
It really is an amazing location.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We finally get to start shooting!
This is so exciting! You memorized all of your lines, right, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm not about to make a fool of myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You sure are pumped up. But that checks out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, to think that you'd be chosen for the lead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, we didn't really have a choice...
I'm the only one who's more or less the same height and build as Soda.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shinonome...
If only my acting skills were a little better...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: My brain and body sorta need to be doing the same thing, you know? My muscles do all the talking for me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that.
Also, no one's good at everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True... But the fight scenes are gonna be your time to shine. Do your best as my stunt double.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're also playing an important role, Shiraishi... The girl who the hero saves... You have a lot on your plate, but I hope you'll give it your best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Will do!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Alright, actors, once you've finished changing, please hurry on over here so I can start doing your makeup!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, gotta go...!
See you in a bit, Kusanagi!
se_run_women_003_1
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're really gonna start shooting soon...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've had to learn a lot of new things for this, but I need to do my best as the director...!)
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: The lights and camera are all set, Director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, the cast should be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're good to go whenever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All ready to go...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're starting with the scene where the girl gets attacked by the Dark Cooks and the hero comes to save her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's also the opening scene, making it a really important one... Ideally, we'll get this right and set the stage for the rest of our shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, everyone... And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Action!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff...
I'm almost home...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “But I'm so hungry...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Maybe if I had just a little... No, stop!
Mom's sick! She needs this more than me!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I'm almost there, Mom.
You'll get to have some food in a little bit...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Shiraishi's doing a really good job...
She's still a little stiff here and there, but she isn't hesitating. That makes her sound really natural...)

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah!
Where do you think you're going, little girl?!”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook B
rows.Line:
“Oh, what's this?!
Your bag is full of... Food!”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook C
rows.Line:
“What a stroke of luck!
I guess this is what they mean by a duck carrying a leek!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “N-No...! You're...”

rows.Speaker: Dark Cook A
rows.Line:
“Bad luck, darling.
This food now belongs to the... U-Uhh...
The Dark Culinary Society!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cut!

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I forgot my line.

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, and my voice sounded really shrill there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay...
This was our first take after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Still, what should I say to them...?
I don't think telling them to sound natural will help...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Are you guys feeling nervous because we're actually shooting now?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Yeah... We practiced a ton, but this is for real now...

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: The thought of everyone at school seeing our film keeps overwhelming my brain...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, what if...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take some deep breaths and relax... After that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's try thinking about having more fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Fun?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. A lot of you are acting for the first time, so I'm sure you're worried about how you're gonna do and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I believe the most important thing is to enjoy playing your characters...

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: We should enjoy playing our characters...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I know how you all feel since I lost sight of that once a long time ago, which didn't end well for me.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think I know what she's talking about. But for now... We should all try to have more fun!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, next take?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Break time!
Don't forget to stay hydrated, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our shoot's going pretty well.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure how things were gonna go at first, but it's been smooth. I really can't thank everyone enough for...)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Surprise!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep...!
S-So cold...!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Haha. We brought you some ice-cold juice. We had it chill specially for our dear director.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? This is for me...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, because you've been working the hardest out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't think that's true...
But thanks. I'll gladly have this.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Great! Also...
This drink is a small token of our appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Yeah, because...

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We know our film's gonna be amazing now!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We put you in a tough spot when we asked you to become the director, but it's coming along really nicely now, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally is. Without her, this thing was probably doomed to become one of those really bad home videos or something.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Exactly. But you've been doing such an awesome job as the director... Our film's starting to look good, which is giving us even more motivation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I've been doing a good job...?

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...!
Let's see this through until the end and make our film an amazing one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best. Together.
